table.label: Table cells and source grid fragments

limitations: Optional dataset replaces table contents with 1–16 keyed rows and 1–10 keyed columns, automatically fitted to the authored table area. Dense or long data is rejected below the minimum readable source-relative text size. Sparse cells/columns preserve the original layout and cannot be combined with dataset.
Native text remains in its original typography, position and ancestor masks. Borders and decorative icons retain original source vector fragments.
Intentionally empty and skeleton areas are decorative when no source text binding exists.
After changing long labels or values, inspect the illustration crop and text fit.
